question: Below what share of rated capacity does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life under the USABC standard?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), 'usabc|end of life|end-of-life|80%|70%|rated capacity|nominal capacity') ORDER BY page, id
